title: Credit report snapshot / 1
description: CreditHistorySnapshot API wrapper. Resolve sibling credit-history-v1.schema.json locally when validating. Provider account history remains separate from optional local token-price equivalents; no inferred billing ledger or local attribution is authorized. Optional missing values are unknown, not zero. Future object properties are allowed.

providerRefreshFailedAt.description: A failed provider refresh makes retained readings historical immediately; it does not imply an unchanged or zero balance.
